title: Command
description: A command from the console to the runtime. Discriminator: type. The args shape for each type is the oneOf branch whose type const matches, and carries the controller's numeric bounds so that an out-of-bounds request is refused before it reaches the controller. The controller still enforces its own bounds; this schema never widens them.

command_id.description: Minted by the client, unique per command: the idempotency key and the handle of the command_result.

args_start_cycle.title: ArgsStartCycle
args_start_cycle.description: One autonomous single-cube cycle. It starts with an empty gripper, so it takes no holding flag.

plan_only.description: true plans and reports without sending a motion command.

args_observe.title: ArgsObserve
args_observe.description: Capture and perceive; commands no motion, so it takes no plan_only flag.

holding.description: Explicit on every command whose behavior depends on it: true when the cube is held, so the gripper stays in the commands and the holding band is enforced. There is no default.

args_return_arm.title: ArgsReturnArm
args_return_arm.description: Return the arm to the saved low scan pose.

plan_only.description: true plans and reports without sending a motion command.

args_scan_scene.title: ArgsScanScene
args_scan_scene.description: Scan the scene: pan-only views at the low-pose shape, starting from the saved low scan pose with the gripper open and nothing held, and ending back at that pose. A motion command, unlike observe, so it takes plan_only and no holding flag.

plan_only.description: true plans and reports without sending a motion command.

args_manual_pan.title: ArgsManualPan
args_manual_pan.description: One pan step: non-zero, at most 6 degrees either way (the controller's step bound).

holding.description: Explicit on every command whose behavior depends on it: true when the cube is held, so the gripper stays in the commands and the holding band is enforced. There is no default.

plan_only.description: true plans and reports without sending a motion command.

args_manual_move.title: ArgsManualMove
args_manual_move.description: One straight tool step: at most 60 mm forward or back and 30 mm up or down, not both zero (the controller's step bounds).

holding.description: Explicit on every command whose behavior depends on it: true when the cube is held, so the gripper stays in the commands and the holding band is enforced. There is no default.

plan_only.description: true plans and reports without sending a motion command.

args_manual_grip.title: ArgsManualGrip
args_manual_grip.description: The gripper alone, to one of the two proven values.

plan_only.description: true plans and reports without sending a motion command.

args_manual_base_pulse.title: ArgsManualBasePulse
args_manual_base_pulse.description: ONE bounded base pulse. seconds is signed (positive forward, negative reverse) with 0.2 <= |seconds| <= 0.8 (the controller's validated durations).

holding.description: Explicit on every command whose behavior depends on it: true when the cube is held, so the gripper stays in the commands and the holding band is enforced. There is no default.

plan_only.description: true plans and reports without sending a motion command.

args_stop.title: ArgsStop
args_stop.description: Stop takes no argument: nothing may make a stop request invalid except a malformed envelope.

command_result.title: CommandResult
command_result.description: What became of a command. uncertain is an explicit outcome: the runtime died between accepting the command and recording the child, so whether anything ran is NOT known and the console must say so. rejected and uncertain always carry a reason_code. Optional extension, so that a receipt says WHICH request it is a receipt for: payload_digest is taken over the canonical command object, so a client that reuses an id with a different body can be told the two are not the same request instead of being answered for the first one; runtime_session names the runtime that admitted the id, so a receipt kept across a restart is not read as a receipt from the runtime now answering; first_seen_wall_utc is when that runtime first admitted it. A receipt from a runtime that records none of them carries none, and a consumer then knows exactly what it knew before.

reason_code.description: a reason_code, required when status is rejected or uncertain
